column3: Close to the Hebrew; מַעַרְכֵי־ (“the arrangements”) is rendered “The preparations.”
Close to the Hebrew; גֹּל (“roll”) is rendered “Commit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for its purpose” is rendered “for Himself,” and “day of evil” “the day of doom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “hand to hand” is rendered “Though they join forces.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” is rendered “mercy and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a balance and scales of justice” is rendered “Honest weights and scales.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְכַפְּרֶנָּה (“atones, pacifies”) is rendered “will appease it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who gives heed to a word” is rendered “He who heeds the word wisely.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the prudence of its owners” is rendered “Understanding… to him who has it,” and “discipline of fools” “correction of fools.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the appetite of a laborer labors for him” is rendered “The person who labors, labors for himself,” and NKJV supplies “hungry.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man of Belial” is rendered “An ungodly man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who shuts his eyes” is rendered “He winks his eye.”
